{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check how many rows are missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper}')

# Check which species have missing flipper_length_mm
df_missing = df[df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]
print('\nSpecies with missing flipper_length_mm:\n', df_missing['species'].value_counts())

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping NaNs (default)
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species:\n', mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find species with highest mean
best_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
best_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {best_species} ({best_value:.2f} mm)')"}
